session.name: Dev-box CPU floor: Defender exclusions + VS Code watcher excludes

goal.original: Stop the dev box sitting at ~42% CPU while agents work. Fabio's normal idle is ~5%; it has forced a reboot before, and it is not a one-off.
goal.summary: Two changes, both environment, neither in app code. (1) Windows Defender real-time scanning over the repo, the engine and the model volume. (2) VS Code file watchers / search over engine/, node_modules/ and .playwright-cli/. Measured contributors, not guesses - see context.measurements.

completed: Diagnosed with a per-process CPU-time delta over a fixed window (Get-Process .CPU before/after, divided by logical cores). Task Manager's CPU column is a rate; the .CPU property is cumulative seconds, so a delta is the honest per-process percentage.
Ruled out this session's own processes as the RESIDENT cause: between steps the box measured 3-4% total with nothing of mine running. The spikes are real but bounded to test/lint/playwright runs.
pending: FIX 1 - Defender exclusions. Needs an ADMIN PowerShell, so Fabio runs it or approves it: Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath "C:\AI\Mpi\Cubric-Vision","G:\CubricModels". The engine dir is inside the repo path, so it is covered. Verify with (Get-MpPreference).ExclusionPath. This is the single biggest line after VS Code itself.

FIX 2 - VS Code excludes. Add files.watcherExclude + search.exclude for engine/**, node_modules/**, .playwright-cli/** to Cubric-Vision.code-workspace. Watchers over a multi-GB engine/ and a full node_modules are what keeps the extension hosts busy.

OPTIONAL - reap stale MCP servers. Counted 4 @playwright/mcp and 6 @modelcontextprotocol node processes, each an npx wrapper plus the real server, i.e. several pairs left from earlier sessions. They die with the VS Code window that spawned them; a window reload is enough and it does NOT touch the running app.
Re-measure after each fix with the same delta method and tell Fabio the new floor. Do not declare it fixed from a single Task Manager glance.

key_decisions: Not applied in the originating session on purpose: Fabio asked for them to be a separate session, and neither belongs to MPI-508.

Defender exclusions are a real security trade, not a free win: they turn off real-time scanning for a tree that downloads model weights from R2 and Hugging Face. Say that out loud to Fabio rather than burying it - he may prefer to exclude only node_modules and engine/.
constraints: `Cubric-Vision.code-workspace` is GITIGNORED (.gitignore:63). Editing it is LOCAL ONLY - a fresh clone or a second machine inherits none of it, so do not treat the fix as shipped for anyone else.

Do NOT re-add the sibling repos to that workspace file while editing it. CLAUDE.md documents why (a workspace folder loads that repo's skills/agents/plugins; permissions.additionalDirectories grants the access without the config).
Never restart or close the user's app or the ComfyUI engine to chase CPU. The engine idles around 2.3% and that is normal.
Fabio's Bun process (5.8% in his Task Manager capture) is NOT ours and was not running at measurement time. Identify it before blaming anything in this repo.
